# Confetti Story Kits

> Where crafting meets storytelling. Printable, story-driven treasure hunts for kids ages 4 to 8, sold as instant downloads on Etsy. Each kit includes rhyming clue cards, a story page, a hiding spot checklist, blank cards for custom clues, a certificate, and a phone Quest Master (a browser page opened by the kit's QR codes) that reads clues aloud, gives hints and celebrates the finish.

Who they're for: parents and birthday hosts, teachers and classrooms, homeschool families and co-ops, scout troops, kids' clubs and after-school programs, libraries and church kids' programs, grandparents and babysitters.

## Kits
- [The Great Birthday Cake Quest](https://confettistorykits.com/kits/birthday-cake/): Birthday kit. The birthday cake has vanished. Follow the clues to find it! Buy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/ConfettiStoryKits
- [The Case of the Missing Treasure](https://confettistorykits.com/kits/missing-treasure/): Detective mystery kit. The treasure box vanished from Detective Headquarters. Crack the case! Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4611065021/detective-treasure-hunt-printable-for
- [The Elf Who Lost Santa's List](https://confettistorykits.com/kits/elf-santas-list/): Christmas kit. A North Pole wind scattered Santa's list. Find every page before Christmas Eve! Buy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/ConfettiStoryKits
